_comment: The shared trading rules. Every desk that loads this file scans the same
band, admits the same names and fires the same alerts, so two traders
running their own IBKR connection see the same screen.
This file is committed. Secrets and machine-specific settings are NOT:
IBKR host and port, client ids, and API keys stay in each machine's .env.
The Confirmed course pillars ($2-20, >=10%, RVOL >=5x, float <20M, news)
are NOT here. They live in code because they are Ross's analysis, not an
operator setting, and the desk fingerprint hashes them so an edit shows up.
